summary: PMA Graphene Technology Group Inc., a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq foreign private issuer formerly named Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd, filed a Form 6-K reporting that shareholders at an August 25, 2026 EGM approved changing the company name and adopting a fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. The Cayman Registrar issued the change-of-name certificate August 26, 2026. Class A ordinary shares trade under the new name on Nasdaq effective September 10, 2026; CUSIP is unchanged and no shareholder action is required. This is a routine corporate-name and charter housekeeping event, not a special situation.
